description: This file declares interfaces related to alias handling, including lookup, quoting command lines, splitting command lines, error reporting, and listing aliases.

methods.name: alias_lookup
methods.description: Looks up the string associated with an alias.

methods.name: quote_cmdline
methods.description: Quotes command-line arguments so they can be safely parsed.

methods.name: split_cmdline
methods.description: Splits a command line string into an argument vector.

methods.name: split_cmdline_strerror
methods.description: Returns a string describing an error code from split_cmdline.

methods.name: list_aliases
methods.description: Lists all defined aliases into a string_list.
